Maths

One mathematics collection, from foundational ideas to advanced topics. Select a mathematical strand, then a lesson. Different year groups and levels belong within the same topic rather than in separate books.

NumberNumbers, sets, operations, proportional reasoning and numerical structure.AlgebraExpressions, equations, patterns, generalisation and algebraic reasoning.FunctionsRelationships, graphs, transformations and mathematical models.GeometryShapes, measurement, constructions, proof and trigonometric relationships.TrigonometryExplore right-angled and general triangles, from SOHCAHTOA and Pythagoras to the sine and cosine rules.StatisticsCollecting, describing, representing and interpreting data.ProbabilityChance, outcomes, events, conditional reasoning and random processes.
